description: Cloud-based accounting software platform for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow and client credentials grant (for custom connections).
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account on the Xero developer portal with a free Starter plan tier (supporting up to 5 connections).
api_notes: Comprehensive Accounting API covering invoices, contacts, bank transactions, accounts, reports, payroll, and more.
mcp_notes: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Xero on GitHub (xero-mcp-server).
rationale: Xero provides self-serve free developer credentials, comprehensive REST APIs, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready to build agent toolkits today.

evidence.note: Details OAuth 2.0 implementation and grant types for Xero APIs
Shows the free Starter developer plan tier with self-serve signup and 5 connections
Outlines the breadth of the Accounting API and other endpoint groups
Official open-source Xero MCP server repository
